description: The assistance is being provided as the Houthis expand their operations along Yemen’s Red Sea coast. Military sources said the group seized the port city of Mocha on Thursday and moved towards strategic islands, including Hanish. Yemeni government military sources said the advances had given the Houthis greater leverage over the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, the southern entrance to the Red Sea and one of the world’s busiest shipping routes.

Also on Thursday morning, the Indian cricket board (BCCI) announced that Harshit Rana had suffered another injury during his match simulation test at the CoE on Tuesday. Pacer Yash Thakur was named as his replacement.

title: Pakistan stops Sikh pilgrims bound for Hemkund Sahib at Faisalabad airport
description: Pakistani authorities stopped Sikh pilgrims from flying to India for their pilgrimage.  Devotees were stranded at Faisalabad International Airport after being asked for an NOC.  Pilgrims missed their scheduled flights to Delhi due to the unexpected requirement.  They had already spent significant money on travel arrangements for the journey.  The group now awaits government permission to travel via the Attari-Wagah land border.

Investigators are examining digital communication between Shalu and one of the alleged contract killers. Shalu's family has rejected the allegations against her, stating she was close to the victim. The investigation continues to establish Subrat's potential involvement in the crime.

title: China-controlled Hong Kong to punish 3 who organised vigils for Tiananmen massacre
description: Hong Kong once had a strong civil society, regular mass protests and a relatively open press. Since the 2019 protest movement, however, the authorities have restricted political participation and prosecuted prominent activists and media figures. Several civil society groups have shut down, including the alliance behind the Tiananmen gatherings. In February, former pro-democracy media tycoon Jimmy Lai was sentenced to 20 years in prison under the security law.

description: Apple's new iPhones cost more this year, not just the Duo, its first foldable, or the 18 Pro. Older models went up too, breaking a five-year run of steady pricing in India. Some of that is tax and currency. Most of it is a global memory shortage, squeezed by AI's appetite for chips. Add India's duty structure and Apple's read on what buyers will pay, and the entry fee for an iPhone has never been higher.

title: Deadly plot by ‘killer bahu’: Kanpur bizman sensed danger, but ended up with 26 stab wounds
description: An alleged murder plot to stage a heart attack was foiled when the victim returned home. The intended suffocation plan changed to a violent stabbing after the victim discovered the attackers. The victim sustained 26 stab wounds during the assault which occurred late at night. The alleged conspirator was reportedly dancing at a lounge while the killing unfolded.

title: Olga Bobrovsky’s emotional goodbye to Florida as Toronto chapter begins

The veteran goalie spent 7 seasons with the Florida Panthers, winning 2 Stanley Cups before signing with the Toronto Maple Leafs. Panthers captain Aleksander Barkov also talked about Bobrovsky’s lasting influence and lauded his exit.

title: Why Apple did not launch successor of the ‘world's most-popular’ iPhone
description: Apple unveiled its iPhone 18 Pro and foldable Duo, skipping the standard model.  This move separates premium and base models into distinct launch cycles.  Memory shortages and supply chain issues likely influenced this strategic decision.  The standard iPhone 18 is now expected in early 2027.  This allows Apple to spread shipments more evenly across financial quarters.

description: A social media trend uses ChatGPT to recreate photos in 1980s styles. Users are now focusing on regional aesthetics, specifically 1980s Kerala and Malayali culture. Prompts request authentic family, wedding, college, and studio portraits from the period. These images incorporate traditional clothing, jewellery, and home settings from Kerala. The AI maintains recognizable facial features while adding retro photographic elements.

The devices also offer extended battery life and higher entry prices.  The iPhone 18 Pro starts at Rs 1,64,900 and the Pro Max at Rs 1,79,900. description: Belgium is constructing the world's first artificial energy island in the North Sea. This massive structure will collect electricity from offshore wind farms and transmit it ashore. The island's design incorporates nature-inclusive elements to support marine life and bird species. While civil engineering nears completion, electrical infrastructure installation will continue until 2030. The project aims to become operational around 2030, enhancing European electricity exchange.
